title: fix(ui): console v18.4.0 sweep — connector input reset, per-field conflict list, share page fields, Studio error box wrap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4obYM5GqkRT57gfAZqPnQ3)_

Fixes #33346

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/plugin-detail` exports the new `ConcurrentUpdateFieldConflict` type, and `ConcurrentUpdateConflict` gains the optional `fields` list. Nothing is removed or narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程设计器切换连接器动作时只保留新动作声明的输入(连同取值或绑定),其余丢弃;行内编辑多字段冲突按字段逐行列出;分享链接页按记录页规则隐藏系统字段;Studio 顶部错误框长文本自动换行。
- 为什么改:v18.4.0 巡检的 6 行观察;其中切换动作后旧输入会被保存并在运行时真的发给新动作,不只是显示问题。
- 风险与回滚:仅 `ui/**` 前端改动,无服务端与协议改动;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`FlowNodeInspector.tsx` 的 `setField` 连接器分支;`ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx` 的逐字段列表;`SharedRecordFields.tsx` 的过滤。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/InlineEditSaveBar.multiFieldConflict-33346.test.tsx`,预期 2 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Flow designer, connector action node (row 254).** Changing a `connector_action` node's connector or action now keeps the inputs the new action declares, each with its value or binding as it was, and drops the rest. When the new action's input schema is not known (no connector catalog, or an action id still being typed), the Input map is empty: nothing undeclared is guessed through. Before, only `actionId` was written, so the old action's keys stayed in the map: undeclared ones drew as extra Input rows, were saved with the flow, and the executor handed them to the new action (`connector-nodes.ts` passes the whole map; shipped input schemas are open). Inputs set aside by a switch are held in the open inspector and come back if the author returns to the same connector and action (the Action box commits per keystroke, so a typo must not lose them); they are never saved meanwhile. File: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx`.
- **Inline edit conflict dialog (row 118).** A 409 `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` on a save that changed several fields lists each field on its own row: label, your edit, current value. Before, both values were the whole maps printed as raw JSON. A one-field conflict looks as before. Files: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` (`buildConflict` adds `fields`), `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx` (renders them), `index.tsx` (type export).
- **Share-link landing page (row 99).** Fields are listed by the record page's own body rule, imported, not restated: `AUDIT_FIELD_NAMES` (`@object-ui/types`) and spec `FIELD_GROUP_SYSTEM_FIELDS` are not listed, and when the resolve answer carries the field projection only declared fields are listed. Labels come from the projection. File: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordFields.tsx`.
- **Studio editor error box (row 147).** The edit is the TOP error box (`ResourceEditPage.tsx` about line 3059, `data-testid="resource-edit-error"`), not the lower located validation banner, which already wrapped. It gains `min-w-0 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]`. The object-list loader and context memo that #33104 edits are untouched.

## Why

The v18.4.0 sweep's console rows. Row 254 was graded up to p2 because stale inputs are sent at run time, not only drawn.

## Tests

One rendered pin per fixed row, each with a CONTROL, each ablated red on its fix:

| Row | Pin | Ablation |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 254 | `FlowNodeInspector.connectorActionSwitch-33346.test.tsx`: a switch to an action that shares `channel` saves `{ channel }` with its expression binding, the rest dropped; CONTROL an action sharing no key saves `input: {}` and draws none of the old values; connector switch resets; an action with no known schema gets `{}` and typing back restores; CONTROL keeps every input on an in-place edit | reset: 3 red, CONTROL green; keep-declared step: the shared-key pin red, the other 4 green |
| 118 | `InlineEditSaveBar.multiFieldConflict-33346.test.tsx`: per-field rows with label and both values, no `{`/`}` in the dialog; CONTROL single-field pair | 1 red, CONTROL green |
| 99 | `SharedRecordPage.systemFields-33346.test.tsx`: declared business fields by label only; an answer without a projection still drops system and audit columns | 2 red |
| 147 | `ResourceEditPage.errorBoxWrap-33346.test.tsx`: the box carries the wrap classes; CONTROL the whole refusal text, untruncated | 1 red, CONTROL green |

Two existing share-page pins were updated to the record-page rule (`SharedRecordPage-26767`, `SharedRecordPage-27121`): an audit column and an undeclared key are no longer listed, and a fixture lookup field named `created_by` was renamed to `sponsor_id` because `created_by` is now an audit column the page hides.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 248 (API key Edit on a revoked key): no change.** The menu already follows the server. The edit whitelist on `sys_api_key` is the `revoked` column alone on every key, live or revoked (`sys-api-key.object.ts`, `userActions: { edit: true }` with the ADR-0092 D2 clamp; Revoke is itself `PATCH {revoked: true}`), so Edit is a real action on every key.
- **Row 246 (revoked-session view subtitle and button): out of scope, server metadata.** The subtitle is `sys_session`'s object description and the button is an object-level `list_toolbar` action with no view scoping (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session.object.ts`). The console renders an object description on every view by design; per the seat ruling there is no ui-side special case. Reported in `out_of_scope_findings`.
- **Row 99, object label: out of scope, server.** The header prints `link.object_name` because the share-link resolve answer carries no object label (`packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts`). The projection also carries no `hidden`, so a hidden non-system field (for example the injected `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`) is still listed. Reported in `out_of_scope_findings`.
- **Row 254, executor: out of scope, server.** The executor passes undeclared keys to an action whose input schema is open. This PR stops the designer from saving them; the runtime half is reported in `out_of_scope_findings`.
- **Accepted deviation (delta review S4): typing an action name.** The Action box saves on every keystroke, so typing from one action name to another passes through names the catalog does not know, and the first of those empties the map. Inputs both actions declare survive a one-shot pick or a paste, not letter-by-letter typing; typing back to the original action still restores its inputs. It fails safe (nothing undeclared is saved, and a required input left empty is refused at run). Also not kept: a key the new action declares but draws no form field for (N4).
- **Size.** 780 changed lines, about 190 source, about 570 pins, 15 changeset (after the review patch that keeps the inputs a new action declares). Past the order's ~600 line; the seat ruled to keep one PR.

## Verification

- Row 147 measured live on the showcase (`objectstack dev --ui`, Playwright, 1440x900), an object field saved without a `type` so the refusal carries the field-type enum list as one unbroken token. Before: the top error box's column had scrollWidth 3067 against clientWidth 1440, the text cut at the right edge. After (console dist rebuilt): the box spans 24 to 1416 px, scrollWidth equals clientWidth (1390), height 106 px with the text wrapped, every ancestor and the document at 1440.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 37 families for this diff; all 37 ran locally on the rebased branch with exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (37 derived, 37 run, 0 not measured). `check:test-source-alias` first exited 1 on the two new app-shell pins (the lazily loaded `@objectstack/lint` was reached inside a clocked case); both pins now import it at module top, and the re-run exited 0.
- Beyond the derivation: the plugin-detail suite plus the four touched test areas (Test Files 414 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 3773 passed), `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`, and eslint on the four touched source files, all exit 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
